summary: Duplicate OpenSpool records on a tag are not rejected before write.
claim: Duplicate OpenSpool records on a tag are not rejected before write.

evidence.source: In NfcCoordinator.handle(), existingOpenSpool list is built but only checked for unsupported records (firstOrNull { it !is DecodeResult.Supported }). If all existing OpenSpool records are Supported, no rejection occurs. decodeSingleOpenSpool() does reject records.size != 1 on read, but the write path bypasses this check and after overwrite consent writes a single record, potentially discarding extra OpenSpool records.

suggested_remediation: Before writing, reject if the number of existing OpenSpool NDEF records is not exactly one, regardless of whether each is Supported.
suggested_validation: Present a tag containing two valid OpenSpool records while in AWAITING_TAG; expect a rejection with duplicate/multiple OpenSpool message and no write.
